items.title: fix(workers): cleanup failures lose their cause after a reply (#137828)
items.summary: fix(workers): cleanup failures lose their cause after a reply (#137828) * fix(agents): preserve results when finalization fails Keep captured output, usage, and delivery evidence when native CLI session continuity cannot be saved or remote computer cleanup fails. Record the failure at its owner, classify replacement results independently, and prevent another model attempt from repeating effects. Preserve typed frozen errors through cleanup, rejecting credential cleanup, and the canonical terminal outcome rather than reporting a false winning model. This is the result-finalization prerequisite split from #136049 (paired Mac cleanup and error preservation), related to #135944 (cleanup hides its cause). It does not include native input lifecycle changes or complete that issue. Validation: 565 selected tests passed; the final test-only cleanup was covered by 77 rerun cases. Completed changed-check component plan, production build, and fresh isolated Codex autoreview (P0 scoped-clean). Live proof follows on this exact source before landing. Production +104; tests +621; docs +2. The added production surface owns retained results and frozen-error no-replay evidence; terminal projection is simplified. * fix(workers): retain acknowledged cleanup failures Drain computer and browser disposal before the worker's finishing ACK. Preserve primary and secondary cleanup causes rather than replacing them with terminal assistant text or a generic launcher error. Capture the applied finishing outcome under its exact operational owner, claim, credential identity, sequence and ACK predicate. Revalidate after publication listeners, consume once before reconciliation releases the owner, and discard retained state on closure or replacement. Keep credential cleanup rejecting and skill-artifact deletion advisory. This is the worker-outcome slice of #136049 (paired-computer cleanup and error preservation), related to #135944 (cleanup hides its native cause). Depends on #137821 (completed CLI actions replay when session saving fails). Native input/tool-lifetime changes remain separate. Validation: 347 tests across 14 integrated suites; actual worker-scoped changed gate; production build; fresh isolated Codex autoreview, P0 scoped-clean. The 35-file tested integration matches this publication tree exactly. Real worker/native failure-path proof is still required before landing. Worker-only delta: production +124, tests +592, docs +2. Tool disposal is net-neutral; new lines own exact acknowledged, one-use finishing evidence. * fix(workers): stop fallback after acknowledged cleanup failures Record replay prohibition at the failing tool-cleanup owner and carry that fact through the existing finishing replayInvalid field. Retain it with the exact acknowledged turn outcome, then mark the launcher's error before workspace reconciliation releases the owner. Provider-only failures keep their existing fallback behavior. A boundary regression through run entry, placement admission, finishing acknowledgement and outer model fallback reproduced a second synthetic effect after cleanup failure. The repaired path executes once and retains the original cause, including when workspace reconciliation succeeds. Proof: 125 owner and 285 sibling cases passed, with eight targeted legitimate-fallback controls and final fixture reruns. Changed checks, full build and fresh whole-worker-PR P0 autoreview passed. Synthetic boundary proof is not live native-input proof. No protocol/schema change. Follow-up to the acknowledged worker-outcome repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/137828. Incremental LOC: production +20, tests +195, docs net zero. * test(agents): use runtime auth reader in thinking fixture --------- Co-authored-by: Jason (Json)

items.title: Apple同步更新macOS三大分支版本，修補逾200個資安漏洞
items.summary: Apple於9月14日同步發布macOS Golden Gate 27、Tahoe 26.7與Sequoia 15.8等三個更新版本，三份公告合計列出逾500個修補項目，扣除共通漏洞後，涉及的獨立漏洞超過200個，其中Golden Gate 27涵蓋216個漏洞，Tahoe 26.7與Sequoia 15.

items.title: 中國駭客Red Heron利用Gitea重大漏洞攻擊臺灣等多個國家
items.summary: Gitea開發團隊於7月底修補重大漏洞CVE-2026-60004，一個月後美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）警告該漏洞遭到積極利用，本週有資安公司指出，有駭客組織在概念驗證程式碼（PoC）公開後不久，將其用於實際攻擊。

items.title: Acronis修補cPanel與WHM備份外掛高風險漏洞，警示已遭攻擊者利用
items.summary: Acronis於9月11日發布更新，修補Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM的高風險漏洞，並警告該漏洞已遭攻擊者實際利用。Acronis未在公告中公布該漏洞的CVE編號、成因或攻擊方式，僅指出受影響的1.9.3以前版本用戶應儘速更新，目前最新版本則是1.9.3 HF3與1.9.4版。

items.summary: 蘋果周一（9/14）正式釋出iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27、visionOS 27及tvOS 27等新一代作業系統，除了效能、連線及Liquid Glass介面等系統升級，也同步推出新一代Apple Intelligence，

items.title: 美AI業界憂中國追上，中國批惡性競爭
items.summary: 中國外交部周一（9/14）回應Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei日前提出的放慢前沿AI發展及防止中國追上等主張，批評散播威脅敘事、搞對抗及惡性競爭，只會干擾全球AI治理進程。

items.title: RouterOS漏洞風險升高！Shadowserver發現全球260萬臺MikroTik路由器暴露於網路，臺灣有近1.9萬臺
items.summary: 波蘭電腦緊急事件應變團隊CERT Polska於9月5日警告，MikroTik路由器作業系統RouterOS存在多項漏洞，部分已遭攻擊者利用；美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）也於9月10日將其中的CVE-2026-67277與CVE-2026-86060列入已遭利用漏洞（KEV）清單。
